name: Typing Fighter
author: Addicting Games
description: Typing Fighter is a free typing game. Life is a never-ending campaign of battles Some of those battles are before us and some of those battles are behind us. But every battle leads to a new now. We at Addicting Games are here to tell you that some of those battles can be made of words and it can be up to you to connect the letters to make words that will change your life. Change it so much, that perhaps you will be at the top of the leaderboard. In Typing Fighter you will use the tips of your fingers or the taps of your mouse in order to click on and connect a series of letters in order to form words. The words will become punches, kicks, and blocks.  Each level is also timed, which means you will be in a rush to punch out as many words as you can as fast as you can. It is a challenging game for smart people who like to think hard, think fast, and think often. If that sounds like you then please by all means play this game, enjoy this game, and try to beat our high score.
